correctness.rationale: A 3-clique in line graph L(K_n) is exactly a three-star or a 3-cycle; hence face condition is equivalent to triangle-free degree≤2 K_n edge sets. I independently regenerated complete 14430 nonempty n7 simplices (cardinality face vector including empty 1,21,210,1155,3570,5607,3507,360) and n6 (1,15,105,375,675,477,60). Deterministic source edge-order toggle matching yields n7 7106 matched pairs, critical one 0-cell, 36 dim4 and 181 dim5; independently topologically sorted all directed face incidences, no cycle. Exact signed recursive gradient-path Morse 36x181 matrix has 801 nonzero entries and Smith diagonal 35 ones then zero; n6 matrix 1x27 has a unit invariant, yielding 26 S4. No low-dimensional positive cells remain, and attaching maps S^d→∨S^d (d≥2) are classified by integer degree vector, so unimodular cell basis moves and unit cancellations yield wedge. n3–n5 source critical-cell models likewise give stated spheres. This is exhaustive finite proof for 2≤n≤7; no n≥8 extrapolation, equivariant or shellability result.
